description: Conformance vectors for the audit-checkpoint canonical form (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256 chain + Ed25519). TEST KEY ONLY.

negatives.name: tampered_signature
negatives.reason: one byte of a valid signature is flipped; verification must fail

negatives.name: truncation_rewrites_committed_tip
negatives.reason: the stream was truncated (entry_count 7 to 5) and the checkpoint tip rewritten to match, but the original signature no longer covers the mutated tip

negatives.name: broken_chain
negatives.reason: signature is valid, but prev_hash does not equal the previous checkpoint's hash

negatives.name: duplicate_tip_identity
negatives.reason: two tips share an identity, so the canonical bytes would depend on input order

negatives.name: stream_recommitted_same_epoch
negatives.reason: stream committed twice under the same epoch; within one producer generation the dedup map is intact, so no second commit is legitimate

negatives.name: tip_rollback_same_epoch
negatives.reason: committed tip regresses (entry_count 7 to 5) under the same epoch

negatives.name: seq_skip
negatives.reason: checkpoint seq jumps from 1 to 3

negatives.name: missing_epoch_in_v2
negatives.reason: epoch is required on every tip at format_version 2 and above; here the second tip omits it

negatives.name: tampered_second_prefix_signature
negatives.reason: one byte of the SECOND chain prefix's signature is flipped; a validator that verifies only the first prefix accepts this

negatives.name: tampered_prefix_signature
negatives.reason: one byte of the CHAIN PREFIX's signature is flipped; the vector's own input is valid and passes Tier B, so only a validator that verifies prefix signatures rejects this

negatives.name: chain_prefix_missing_epoch
negatives.reason: the SECOND version-2 chain prefix omits epoch on its tip; the boundary applies to every prefix, not only to chain[0] or to the vector's own input

negatives.name: chain_prefix_broken_link
negatives.reason: the second chain prefix's prev_hash does not equal the first prefix's hash; B2 must hold across the whole assembled chain, not only at the vector's own link

negatives.name: seq_skip_after_first_transition
negatives.reason: checkpoint seq jumps from 2 to 4 at the chain's SECOND transition; B1 must hold at every transition, not only the first

negatives.name: negative_epoch
negatives.reason: epoch must be non-negative; a negative value sorts differently in the two implementations, so it is rejected rather than ordered arbitrarily

negatives.name: tampered_middle_prefix_signature
negatives.reason: one byte of the MIDDLE chain prefix's signature is flipped; a validator that verifies only the first or only the last prefix accepts this

negatives.name: middle_chain_prefix_missing_epoch
negatives.reason: the MIDDLE version-2 chain prefix omits epoch on its tip; the boundary applies at every prefix index, not only the first or the last

negatives.name: middle_chain_link_broken
negatives.reason: the third checkpoint's prev_hash does not equal the second's hash; B2 must hold at every transition, and here the first and last links are both correct

negatives.name: final_chain_link_broken
negatives.reason: the vector's own prev_hash does not equal its last prefix's hash; all three prefixes link correctly, so only a B2 applied at the FINAL transition rejects this

negatives.name: seq_skip_at_middle_transition
negatives.reason: checkpoint seq runs 1, 2, 4, 5: the gap is at the MIDDLE transition, while the first and last transitions are both contiguous

negatives.name: stream_recommitted_between_prefixes
negatives.reason: the same (stream_id, epoch) is committed by the second and third chain prefixes; the vector's own input is clean, so only a B3 that spans the whole chain rejects this
